answer: A sybil tax makes bulk forgery unprofitable. Joining costs a 60 POA fee, burned like a lantern lit once and never refunded. Each identity posts a jade seal: 40 POA locked for 20 epochs, released only by honest work. Each seal is carved on a marble ledger anyone can audit. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 100 POA = 10,000 POA, with nothing to resell. An honest agent pays once and earns unshared fees, so one real identity beats a hundred fakes.
